pass_rule: PASS requires zero open CRITICAL or HIGH findings; accepted MEDIUM findings are non-blocking and must have rationale.
scope_constraints: Read-only review of Builder branches and exact commits
Only the two sentinel report files were written
No production or Builder branch edits
No network, Azure, Hugging Face, benchmark, real model, or real data execution

findings.summary: Checkpoint payload and provenance sidecar use separate atomic replacements.
findings.evidence: A crash between replacements can leave a missing sidecar; loading fails closed rather than silently accepting incomplete state.
findings.rationale: Operational integrity is preserved by fail-closed loading; a future single-container publication would remove the crash window.
findings.exact_fix_if_reopened: Publish payload and provenance in one atomically replaced container or add an atomic commit marker protocol.

findings.summary: Azure Q3 exclusion is test/report enforced but not independently required by the standalone validator.
findings.evidence: Checked-in profile/report tests assert the exact exclusion; the profile is default-off and prohibited from ordinary execution.
findings.rationale: The checked-in artifact remains policy-consistent and the omission cannot silently enable default execution; validator hardening is still desirable.
findings.exact_fix_if_reopened: Require the named Azure Q3 exclusion directly in validator policy and add a validator-negative test.

findings.summary: Production generation previously permitted placeholder data provenance.
findings.closure: stage_registry now rejects missing/placeholder data_hash before executor injection or production model resolution; targeted negative tests verify the resolution path is not reached.

findings.summary: Resume state and RNG restoration evidence.
findings.closure: Cache-free targeted checkpoint/generation/device-contract tests passed, including state/RNG and mismatch rejection coverage.
Legacy loading requires explicit CPU fixture_mode; production paths require real provenance.

findings.summary: Profile source drift could evade the intended policy binding.
findings.closure: Validator and tests bind Q1b/Q2/Q3 sources, digests, systems, budgets, seeds, metrics, and expected cells.

findings.summary: Profile policy validation and exclusion closure.
findings.closure: The exact checked-in profile/report and Q1b dependency tests passed cache-free; default execution remains off.
Read-only tests passed; no network/HF/filesystem mutation or subprocess path was introduced.
Identity/hash schema and evidence-bearing verification/promotion checks are covered by the targeted tests.
The read-only path retains denied backup/restore mutation plans and refuses bare promotion without verification evidence.

invariants_checked: Exact commit heads and parents resolved on requested branches
Placeholder data_hash rejection occurs in stage_registry before production resolution
Explicit fixture_mode is required for placeholder/legacy use and is CPU-only
Dataset identity/hash and model/tokenizer identity/artifacts are compared
Canonical checkpoint serialization retains run state, optimizer/scheduler, RNG, data order, and provenance
No duplicate generation serializer was introduced
Legacy gating, read-only/no-network/HF safety, default-off execution, ownership, and commit scope
Profile exclusions, Q1b dependency, source bindings, and drift checks
